title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Thu 29 Oct
summary: A flat day (forecast flat). Thermals stayed flat all day. The upslope ran from about 08:15 to about 16:30. A low day for October: the base stayed down near 3,100 ft (normal 4,500–5,400 ft). The evening before, the page called it normal, about 3,700 ft, a miss. Midday the base averaged about 3,100 ft by the Kekoa camera, 600 ft lower than the evening's number; the morning update said about 3,600 ft, off by 500 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway between Pukalani and Omaopio; furthest south about 16:52, crossing Kula Highway between Omaopio and the middle Lower Kula Road junction. Data gaps: no readings all day from 3 stations (Kahikinui, Nakula, Upper Kahikinui); the Mesonet could not be reached on 17 of 60 updates.
